senses.gloss:
Auḍulomi
ancient authority on Vedānta ref. to by Bādarāyaṇa in the Brahmasūtras (I. iv. 21, III. iv. 45, IV. iv. 6); in the Saṅkarṣakāṇḍa III. i. 12 (p. 122, Mad. Uni. edn. 1966).
--authority on Dharma mentioned by Rudradeva in his Pākayajñaprakāśa (Mu7nchen 78) a. having been q. by Bharadvāja.
